jobs.title: Laboratory Technician Senior
jobs.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As a Lab Tech Professional, you will perform vital clinical laboratory procedures to detect, identify, measure, and report data crucial for disease diagnosis and treatment.  
  
Every day, you will expertly conduct waived and moderate procedures using technical skills, instrumentation, and information systems, providing essential clinical laboratory support while ensuring the quality and accuracy of all tests under leadership direction.  
  
To be successful in this role, you will possess comprehensive knowledge of laboratory principles across various disciplines (microbiology, hematology, chemistry, etc.), understand sample processing and result interpretation, prioritize chemical and biological safety, and be adept at operating and maintaining lab equipment.

* Ensures a professional and responsive atmosphere by greeting patients, visitors, staff, and physicians promptly and courteously. Refers to each individual by name when appropriate. Screens individuals by requesting to see identification or visitor pass.
* Independently perform venous, arterial and capillary punctures.
* Willingness to actively participate in continue education, competency tests, and attends inservice training seminars to update knowledge and skills.
* Demonstrates knowledge and operation of the Laboratory (LIS) and the Hospital (HIS) computer system. This includes validating, recording and reporting tests results via phone, computer entry, and instrument verification protocol in a timely manner.
* Follow written or oral instructions. Accept responsibility and work with minimal supervision.
* Recognizes and prioritizes tasks appropriately. Respond to emergencies, adapt to changing situations and cope with stress in a professional manner.

**Job Requirements**

Required

* High School GED, upon hire or
* High School Graduate, upon hire
* One year of full-time clinical hospitallaboratory phlebotomy experience(including venous, arterial and capillarypuncture techniques) within the last twoyears.
* Phlebotomist: CA, upon hire

Preferred

* Two years laboratory experience

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1950, Dignity Health - Sequoia Hospital is a 208-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in Redwood City, California. Serving over 50,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including heart care, stroke care, and a birthing center. Additionally, Sequoia Hospital has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Joint Commission-certified Primary Stroke Center, and recently was awarded the AMA/ASA’s Get the Guidelines - Stroke Gold Plus Quality Achievement, recognizing the hospital’s commitment to providing the best stroke care. It was recently named a Leapfrog 2025 Top General Hospital.

One Community. One Mission. One California

 **Pay Range**  
$35.30 - $43.43 /hour

jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate Medical Device
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

Bracane Company is looking for a driven and detail-oriented Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to join our Medical Device team in Southern, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in advancing innovative medical device technologies through rigorous clinical research. If you're passionate about improving patient outcomes and thrive in a fast-paced, science-driven environment, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities:**

* Monitor clinical trial sites to ensure compliance with study protocols, GCP, and FDA regulations for medical device studies
* Conduct site initiation visits, routine monitoring visits, and close-out visits at investigational sites
* Review and verify accuracy of Case Report Forms (CRFs) and source documentation
* Serve as the primary point of contact between Bracane Company and clinical investigation sites
* Identify, document, and resolve site-level issues, deviations, and protocol violations
* Ensure proper accountability and storage of investigational devices at study sites
* Prepare detailed monitoring visit reports and track action items to resolution
* Support regulatory submissions, including IDE applications and clinical study reports

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 3+ years of CRA experience, preferably in medical device clinical trials
* Strong knowledge of FDA regulations (21 CFR Parts 812, 50, 54, 56) and ICH-GCP guidelines
* Experience with medical device IDE studies or Class II/III device trials is highly preferred
* Proficiency with electronic data capture (EDC) systems and clinical trial management systems (CTMS)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
* Ability to travel up to 50% to local clinical sites as needed
* Self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing multiple site relationships simultaneously

**About Us:**

Bracane Company is a respected leader in the medical device industry, dedicated to developing cutting-edge solutions that make a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Our clients and partners trust us for our commitment to scientific excellence, regulatory integrity, and innovation. At Bracane Company, employees thrive in a collaborative culture that values professional growth, work-life balance, and the shared mission of advancing healthcare.

Flexible work from home options available.
